title: Math class
prompt: Classify each number set example into the narrowest listed category.
triples: 12 is a counting number, so it is natural.
Negative whole numbers are integers but not natural numbers.
A fraction of two integers is rational.
Pi cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers.
The square root of 2 is irrational.
0 is an integer; this quiz treats natural numbers as positive counting numbers.
